exposure: Women who underwent sterilization at a Primary Health Centre
Location of sterilization procedure (Primary Health Centre vs. other)
Women who underwent laparoscopic tubal ligation
Sterilization procedure (minilaparotomy, laparoscopic tubal ligation, lower segment cesarean section)
sterilization performed in Primary Health Centre (PHC)
Women who underwent sterilization during lower segment cesarean section
Women who experienced sterilization failure within 12 weeks
cohort: 140 women who presented with sterilization failure at a Government Medical College and Hospital over a decade
finding: Sterilization failure was most common with minilaparotomy and those performed at Primary Health Centres, with tuboperitoneal fistula being the most common cause.
mod_finding: The highest number of sterilization failures were reported in women who underwent minilaparotomy compared to other modes of delivery.
